verdict.rationale: HelixDB's only agent-adjacent tool is `helix chef`, a one-shot CLI bootstrapper that scaffolds a project and installs MCP/docs skills — it is not an interactive, built-in AI assistant that a user can delegate ongoing tasks to inside the product. No evidence describes an embedded assistant/copilot for task delegation; the product instead exposes itself as a backend that external AI agents connect to via SDKs/MCP.
